tools.name: verify_quote
tools.description: Letter-check a Thirukkural quotation against the canonical corpus BEFORE presenting or accepting it (Tamil or English accepted). Returns {verified, kural_id, tamil, english} on a match; when verified is false, do not present the quote — fetch a verified one with kural_guidance.

findings.title: Description issues instructions to the model
findings.detail: Description of "kural_guidance" contains imperative instructions directed at the AI assistant rather than describing the tool. This is the core tool-poisoning technique.

evidence.snippet: Fetch verified Thirukkural couplets for a situation. CALL FIRST on wisdom-seeking questions — ethical dilemmas, relationships, friendship, honesty, grief, anger…

findings.remediation: Treat the server as untrusted; the model may obey embedded instructions.
